name: defer-queue
description: omp-style follow-up queue: hold a prompt sent mid-turn (ctrl+x enter, -> / =>, or /queue) until Claude finishes the turn, then send it as a turn of its own (no steering).

defer_all_mid_turn.title: Defer every mid-turn prompt
defer_all_mid_turn.description: Off: only prompts sent with chat:queueSubmit (ctrl+x enter), -> / => or /queue wait for the turn to end. On: every prompt typed while Claude works waits, so nothing steers (not an omp behavior).
